front.title: Continuity Evidence Records for Delegated Agent Systems

abstract.t: This document proposes an experimental, signed JSON statement and verification model for observing computational-agent continuity across sessions, instances and delegations. It distinguishes model, runtime, agent, grant and execution identifiers, retains predecessor evidence, and produces three-valued verification outcomes. Integrity of a record never implies permission to perform an action. This is not an OAuth token format or a claim of standardized identity ontology.
